user.title: Add an ESPaper display
user.description: Pick the panel to control. It only advertises for a couple of seconds every minute, so it may take a moment to appear.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Add {name}? A text entity will be created; whatever Markdown you put in it is rendered and uploaded the next time the panel wakes.

abort.no_devices_found: No ESPaper displays have been seen yet. The panel advertises for about two seconds a minute, so wait a moment and try again.

set_markdown.name: Set Markdown
set_markdown.description: Set the Markdown shown on the panel. Unlike the text entity this is multi-line and has no 255-character limit.

markdown.name: Markdown
markdown.description: Markdown to render. Supports headings, bullet and numbered lists, bold, code spans, block quotes and horizontal rules.

set_rotation.name: Set rotation
set_rotation.description: Turn the layout on the panel, for a display hung on its side or upside down.
